build_VGG19_perceptual_loss: build a VGG19 feature extractor that returns 5 intermediate feature maps for perceptual loss
create_ResNetEncoder: create a ResNet encoder using ResNet_Block layers from a config architecture for encoding images
create_ResNetDecoder: create a ResNet decoder using ResNet_Block layers with optional tanh normalization for decoding
build_Unet_image_translation: build a full U-Net model with encoder-decoder skip connections for 2D image-to-image translation
create_UNet3D_voxel_processing: create a 3D U-Net model with Conv3d layers and trilinear upsampling for volumetric voxel processing
